PLEASE ENTER THIS STATE APPLICATION IDENTIFIER INTO BLOCK I OF STANDARD FORM 240
Applicant: U. S. Department of the Interior Project Title: Endangered Species Conservation Act
This is to inform you that your application to apply for federal aid is being processed by this agency and has been assigned a State Application Identifier (SAI). The SAI remains the same for Letter of Intent, Environmental Impact Statement, and Application on any single project. The SAI should be used as a reference in all future correspondence to this agency and the federal funding agency regarding this project.
The form above the dotted line is to be used as a cover page and should be attached to the final application when it is submitted to the federal funding agency and to this agency. This cover page may be reproduced as needed.
When you submit the final application to the federal funding agency, please enter the date of submission into the space provided below and return the lower portion of this page to the State Office of Planning and Programming, P. O. Box 94601 - State Capitol, Lincoln, Nebraska 68509.
We wish you success in your application and are neady to give you any further assistance.
